description:
Profile

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field;
  • 1–5 years of hands-on C++ development experience (C++11/14/17);
  • Experience with Linux, embedded systems, and real-time software;
  • Strong knowledge of multithreading, IPC, and communication protocols (TCP/UDP, Serial, CAN);
  • Experience with software/hardware integration and interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, and Ethernet;
  • Experience with Git, CMake, and Linux debugging tools;
  • Good written and spoken English.

Preferred Experience

  • Yocto / Buildroot, cross-compilation, Linux drivers, RTOS, or ARM;
  • Python or Bash scripting;
  • Defense, aerospace, automotive, or other safety-critical environments.
